rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0001
rows.name:
*yaaawn* Another peaceful night...
Oh, that's unusual! Visitors from
outside the village.

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0002
rows.name:
We split up the work between
us here in the village. I
do the nightly rounds.

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0003
rows.name:
There's your odd Bunnit that creeps
in, but aside from that, it's not very
eventful. All the better, really.

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0101
rows.name:
Rex? Is that you?! You've
grown since I last saw you!

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0104
rows.name: Haha... I suppose I have, yeah!

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0102
rows.name:
Correl-san was worried about you.
Whether you're eating properly, or
being tricked by bad adults...

rows.label: tlk47300164_01_msg0103
rows.name:
But I can see you're perfectly fine!
And you've made nice friends too, so
that should put her mind at ease!
